run_eval_main: run the main eval function to classify predictions against a dataset using a judge model
run_classify: run the classify function to batch-classify line-prediction pairs using a zero-shot judge model
run_parse: run the parse function to extract a Correct, Incorrect, or Refuse label from a model reply
review_classify: review the classify function that renders Jinja templates and calls parse_zero_shot_with_retries on an OfflineModel
review_parse: review the parse function that uses a regex to extract a label from a judge model response
